name: lemon1_loop
note: Lemon bite gag, 16-frame completed sequence @10FPS (1.6s; widget rate 0.7, play 1-2 cycles). From idle she pulls a whole lemon from behind her back, presents it, bites it, her face scrunches up sour and she shivers, shakes it off with a big exhale, grins with a thumbs-up, hides the lemon behind her back and returns to idle. PROP RULES: the lemon is ALWAYS in the hand on the RIGHT side of the image; opaque bright yellow; whole until the bite, then shows a big bite mark for the rest.
